notes.title: Satan's Dungeon V2 Update1
notes.content:
Changes in the new version of Satan's Dungeon:
Added a hint system and new dialogues to the game

Added Chinese and Russian languages to game subtitles

Redesigned the second level of the game (Maze)

Fixed identified bugs

Made the game lighter and more optimized

Facilitated access to different endings

Improved game UI

Improved achievement system
